name: io.github.XBP-Europe/sagemath-mcp
title: SageMath
description: Stateful SageMath MCP server with 40 tools and a sandboxed Sage session per client.

runtimeArguments.name: --from
runtimeArguments.description: Installs the passagemath extra, which brings the Sage runtime (about 1 GB, downloaded on first launch). Without it the server starts but every evaluation fails for want of a Sage to drive.

packageArguments.name: --transport
packageArguments.description: The image serves streamable HTTP by default; a client that runs it with docker run -i speaks stdio.
